# openbim-ifc

Facade for the openBIM IFC crates: pick codecs and domains as features.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Status | <span class="status-implemented">Implemented</span> |
| Latest release | 0.42.0 (2026-11-09) |
| Registries | [crates.io `openbim-ifc`](https://crates.io/crates/openbim-ifc) |

## Overview

`ifc` — the facade. Pick your codecs and domains as cargo features.

## Features

| Feature | Default | What it enables |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alignment` |  | [`ifc-alignment`](./ifc-alignment): IFC4x3 linear positioning: alignments, referents, linear placement, spirals. |
| `approval` |  | [`ifc-approval`](./ifc-approval): Bounded IFC4 approval resource semantics. |
| `author` |  | Schema-checked authoring (`authoring`) with every bundled release (`schema`). |
| `authoring` |  | Schema-checked authoring (`ifc-author`) and the checked authoring batch (`apply_authoring`), against the releases the build names; with `properties`, numbers read in SI (`apply_authoring_with`). |
| `classification` |  | [`ifc-classification`](./ifc-classification): Classification systems, document references, libraries, external references. |
| `codecs` |  | Both codecs: STEP and ifcXML. |
| `colour` |  | The surface colour of each product's Body (`product_colours`): the item's styled item, its styled presentation layer, else its material's styled representation (layer, profile and constituent sets resolved per item), with the source and a typed refusal; and what decides it, a material also while unstyled (`ColourResolver::product_decider`). Kernel-free. |
| `constraint` |  | [`ifc-constraint`](./ifc-constraint): Bounded IFC4 metric, objective, and constraint relationships. |
| `control` |  | [`ifc-control`](./ifc-control): Bounded IFC control semantics: permits, project orders, action requests, and performance history. |
| `cost` |  | [`ifc-cost`](./ifc-cost): Cost semantics as a borrowed view over the IFC model. |
| `domains` |  | Every domain view, plus authoring and spatial traversal. |
| `element-type` |  | [`ifc-element-type`](./ifc-element-type): Element, resource, and process type definitions: the IfcTypeObject catalogue. |
| `full` |  | Everything: codecs and ifcZIP, schema tables, every domain, catalogues, geometry and meshes, georeferencing and alignment. |
| `geometry` |  | Representation selection plus lowering into the neutral geometry DAG. |
| `geometry-select` |  | Representation selection only: contexts, plan/body choice, placements and units, with no geometry kernel. |
| `geometry-wire` |  | Each product's Body as Axiolid's neutral geometry graph (`product_graphs`), exact and in world metres, encodable in Axiolid's versioned wire format (1.0; 1.1 where a station carries a seam-snapping window, 1.2 where a run's sections do, 1.3 where an offset run continues to a basis end the kernel measures, 1.4 where a polygonal bounded half-space clips) as JSON or CBOR (`ifc::geometry::wire`); a typed refusal per product. Computes nothing; adds the lowering and serde. |
| `georef` |  | [`ifc-georef`](./ifc-georef): Georeferencing: map conversion, coordinate reference systems, site placement. |
| `ifc2x3` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC2X3 TC1 table. |
| `ifc4` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4 ADD2 TC1 table. |
| `ifc4x1` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4X1 FINAL table. |
| `ifc4x2` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4X2 FINAL table. |
| `ifc4x3` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4X3 ADD2 table. |
| `ifcxml` |  | [`ifc-xml`](./ifc-xml): ifcXML (ISO 10303-28) codec for the IFC model. |
| `js-random` |  | Random `GlobalId`s (`new_guid`) and batch seeds (`fresh_seed`) on `wasm32-unknown-unknown` from the JavaScript host's `crypto.getRandomValues`; without it both refuse there; native targets always have them. |
| `material` |  | Material views (`ifc-material`): layer sets, profile sets, constituents, usage; together with `geometry-select`, each layered wall's, slab's or plate's material layer bounds in its object frame (`material_layer_bounds`), and with `mesh` its Body split into one mesh per layer (`material_layer_meshes`). |
| `material-templates` |  | Material views together with the property template catalogue. |
| `mesh` |  | Triangle meshes per product (`product_meshes`, `product_meshes_for` a representation purpose, with solid or surface closure) and polylines of curve representations (`product_curves`: Axis, FootPrint, annotation curves, each with a certified chord bound) through `ifc-geometry`'s reference compile backend: positions relative to each product's world placement, its surface colour (`colour`), a typed refusal per product. Opt-in; links an execution provider (ADR 0004, ADR 0012). |
| `occurrence` |  | [`ifc-occurrence`](./ifc-occurrence): Built element and distribution occurrence classes and their type pairing. |
| `properties` |  | Property sets, quantities and unit resolution (`ifc-properties`); together with `geometry-select`, door and window operation geometry; together with `spatial`, element properties by spatial container; together with `style`, a material's cut fill as hatch line families in metres and radians (`material_fill`, `material_fills`, `material_fills_by_context`, `material_fill_for_view`, `fill_area_style`, `FillResolver`). |
| `property-catalog` |  | The PSD/QTO template catalogue (`ifc-template-catalog`), every edition embedded. |
| `property-catalog-runtime` |  | The PSD/QTO template catalogue installed at runtime from pinned per-edition snapshot files; nothing embedded. |
| `resource` |  | [`ifc-resource`](./ifc-resource): Construction resources: labour, equipment, material, crew, subcontract. |
| `schedule` |  | [`ifc-schedule`](./ifc-schedule): IFC scheduling: IfcTask/IfcWorkSchedule, sequencing, 4D linkage. |
| `schema` |  | The schema API with every bundled release (IFC2X3, IFC4, IFC4X1, IFC4X2, IFC4X3). |
| `schema-api` |  | The schema API without a bundled release; implied by each release feature. |
| `selector` |  | The selector query language (`ifc::selector`, grammar 1.0): filter elements by class, `GlobalId`, attribute, property, type, material, classification, location and group, with typed parse errors carrying byte spans; read and write values by path (`type.Name`, `Pset_WallCommon.FireRating`) through a checked transaction. Property facets need `properties` too. |
| `sheet` |  | Tables of values by path (`ifc::sheet`, #474): export selected entities by attribute, property, quantity and relation paths as CSV or TSV, and import a table back by `GlobalId` or id as one checked transaction, with a planned diff and typed refusals by row and column. |
| `sheet-xlsx` |  | `sheet` with XLSX workbooks too, through the pure-Rust `rust_xlsxwriter` (write) and `calamine` (read) crates. |
| `spatial` |  | [`ifc-spatial`](./ifc-spatial): IFC spatial containment and objectified relationship traversal: project, site, building, storey, element. |
| `step` | yes | [`ifc-step`](./ifc-step): STEP physical file (ISO 10303-21) codec for the IFC model. |
| `structural` |  | [`ifc-structural`](./ifc-structural): Structural analysis model: members, connections, actions, reactions, loads. |
| `style` |  | [`ifc-style`](./ifc-style): Presentation: styles, colours, textures, layers, annotation. |
| `systems` |  | [`ifc-systems`](./ifc-systems): Distribution systems, ports, and connectivity between elements. |
| `tabular` |  | [`ifc-tabular`](./ifc-tabular): Structured IFC value containers indexed by position or time. |
| `validate` |  | [`ifc-validate`](./ifc-validate): Schema conformance: WHERE rules, cardinality, GUID and reference integrity. |
| `validate-express` |  | Validation (`validate`) with the EXPRESS rule evaluator (`ifc::validate::express`): every WHERE rule, type rule and global rule of a release, evaluated from the `.exp` text the caller supplies (#461). |
| `zip` |  | ifcZIP (`ifc::ifczip`, `ifc::ifczip::IfcZipCodec`): read an archive holding one STEP or ifcXML model within a decompression budget, and write one; Stored and Deflate only, through the pure-Rust `zip` and `flate2` (miniz_oxide) crates. |

## Changes

Latest release, 0.42.0 (2026-11-09):

### Fixed (#610)

- `product_meshes` triangle order is deterministic: `axiolid-mesh-compile` 0.3.44 flips Delaunay edges deterministically (axiolid/kernel#425), so a product's mesh no longer differs from call to call or between a subset and the whole model. Floor raised to 0.3.44.

### Changed (#705)

- `material_layer_bounds` and `material_layer_meshes` accept a layered Body of several coaxial extrusions, such as a wall interrupted at a crossing (see `ifc-geometry`).

### Changed (#706)

- Breaking: `MaterialLayerMeshes` positions are now in the object frame `bounds` is stated in, whatever the representation context's `WorldCoordinateSystem`, and `MaterialLayerMeshes::world` is the Body's full frame (the context frame above the product's placement), so `world` applied to a position is still its world position. Results for an identity context frame are unchanged; with another one, positions no longer carry the context frame and `world` includes it.

### Added (#709)

- `History::rollback` (re-exported from `ifc-model`): undoes the newest entry
  and drops it, leaving nothing to redo.

Semver: minor (additive).

### Changed (#603)

- Breaking: `ColourResolver` reports the colour that all materials of a layer, profile or constituent set state as `ColourSource::MaterialSet { definition, materials }` naming the set (`IfcMaterialLayerSet`, `IfcMaterialProfileSet`, `IfcMaterialConstituentSet` or `IfcMaterialList`, or a usage of one (`IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage`, `IfcMaterialProfileSetUsage` and its `Tapering`)) and the materials of the set that colour the item: every one, or the constituents its shape aspects name (ascending id, distinct), instead of `Material` of the first. A set of one material keeps `Material`; differing styles stay `ColourError::AmbiguousMaterial`. `ColourSource` and `SurfaceColour` are no longer `Copy` (`ifc-style`).

Semver: minor (pre-1.0 breaking).

### Fixed (#695)

- `georeferencing` no longer answers an empty list when the reader's damage may have hidden what its presence gate scans. After a lenient read, a skipped record or a diagnostic the reader's classification cannot place refuses with `GeorefError::RecordsIncomplete` behind either gate (the IFC2X3 property-set test and the IFC4 operation scan), and a reported duplicate of a property set the IFC2X3 gate reads refuses with `GeorefError::RecordDamaged`. Clean models and damage elsewhere still resolve to an empty list.

### Added (#636)

- `AuthorOp::ReassignClass` reassigns type objects (`IfcTypeObject` to `IfcTypeObject`). `ReassignClassOptions::move_pairs`: where the new class's type rule does not accept the other end of a type assignment, that end is reassigned too (an occurrence's type to the class its rule names, a type's unsatisfied occurrences to the class that type pairs with), each in `ReassignReport::paired`. Classes pair by rule owner (`IfcWall.CorrectTypeAssigned` with `IfcWallType`), checked against the normative EXPRESS. `AuthoringFailure::TypeNotAccepted`, `PairNotReassigned`. IFC2X3 declares no type rules; nothing is paired there.

### Changed (#636)

- `TypeRuleChanged` is raised only when the new class's type rule differs from the old class's and the type object's class is not the type class the new rule requires.
- `RemovedRelationship::object` names the object taken out of the relationship: the reassigned entity, or, for a type object reassigned with `remove_relationships`, the occurrence whose type assignment was detached.
- A `move_pairs` occurrence whose class the schema does not declare, or that no type class pairs with, is refused with `PairNotReassigned` (cause `UnsupportedReassignment`).

### Added (#635)

- `ReassignClassOptions::remove_relationships`: a reassignment takes the entity out of the relationships the new class cannot hold (`WrongReferenceType`, `RelationshipLost`, `TypeRuleChanged`) as `AuthorOp::Remove` detaches. `ReassignReport::removed_relationships` lists each (`RemovedRelationship`, `RelationshipConflict`). Only `IfcRelationship`s are touched; `InverseCardinality` is still refused; a removal that leaves another entity below a mandatory inverse (an opening's `VoidsElements`) is refused with `AuthoringFailure::RelationshipRequired`.

### Added (#661)

- With `geometry-select`: `BodyItem::swept_disk` and `SweptDisk`: radius, inner radius, fillet radius, directrix and authored `StartParam`/`EndParam` of `IfcSweptDiskSolid` and `IfcSweptDiskSolidPolygonal`, in the item frame.

### Changed (#661)

- With `geometry-select`: a swept disk with a non-positive radius, a bore at least its radius, a half-open range or a non-positive fillet now refuses `body_description`.

Semver: minor.

### Fixed (#670)

- `AuthorOp::ReassignClass` no longer treats `IfcEvent.CorrectTypeAssigned` as a type rule: it checks `EventTriggerType`, not the type object, so a typed object reassigned to `IfcEvent` is not refused with `TypeRuleChanged`.

Semver: patch (refusals narrowed).
